title: Timekeeping and Seasons
summary: Biblical people marked life by seasons, appointed times, harvest cycles, and the ordered work of God under heaven.
background: Agrarian life made seasons visible through planting, harvest, rain, heat, and feast rhythms. Ecclesiastes uses these patterns to reflect on human limits and God’s sovereignty over time.
teachingHelp: When teaching time and seasons, help listeners see the difference between human control and faithful trust under God’s wise rule.
